strings.en: Man, everywhere we go, it's nothing but
fighting. What the heck is going on?
...But to reach the truth, we have to keep fighting... Quite the dilemma.
Either way, nothing starts until we get back to the surface.
Can we really get back? What if we end up never being able to go back...
Then we just live here. I kind of like this place.
Whaaat! I still want the surface!
Me too! I want the surface, where Domon is!
I have to... get back to the surface, too...
Right. Show... if we really
go to this place called Drake's castle, can we get back to the surface?
...Honestly... I don't know.
But there, the one who summons surface people is Silky Mau,
an E Ferario.
There might be a way to send people back to the surface, too.
It's unsettling that nothing's certain...
Even so... we have no choice but to try.
That's right... I must ask you to go.
Lady Sheela...
Holy Warrior Show Zama, and all of you...
Byston Well now faces a threat to its very existence...
brought on by the wicked machines of the surface.
And the root of it all is the one who thought to summon surface people
to build up his own power: Drake...
If there's a way to call people here... there's a way to send them back?
Right now it's all we can bet on. And... it's for Byston Well's sake, too.
Yes. As long as we're surface people... that's our responsibility.
Besides, those bone-like enemies that have appeared lately... I feel they
belong neither to the surface nor to Byston Well.
So they really are invaders from outer space?
What's outer space?
Who knows? Do you know, Cham?
Nope. Hey, Show...
I'll tell you some other time.
You always say that! Tell me properly!
It's a long story.
In any case, right now let's defeat Drake and rescue Silky Mau.
Then it's decided.
We've received some news, Show.
That Wil Wiph you fought at Karakara...
apparently took more damage than anyone thought.
Seems it can't sortie yet. So Drake's castle is in an uproar right now.
They're deploying tons of Aura Battlers in case anyone attacks.
...So if we attack now... we won't have to worry about the battleship.
But there'll be tooons of Aura Battlers, right?
The barrier will be tough, but if we put Getter, Kurojishi, Houraiou...
and the Nobel Gundam out front, it's not impossible.
Enemies in the air are a pain... but we can't complain about that now.
I'd hate it more if the battleship came out.
...That settles it. We've got no choice but to go!
We have the Goraon as well. Strike all at once, and we can win...
We will help as well, so that the surface people can return home.
Thank you.
Show Zama, I don't know how much help this will be...
but I give you our new Aura Battler, the Billbine. Please put it to use.
...Billbine...?
It's a new model our engineers built based on the Dunbine.
It's a prototype, so there's only one, but I vouch for its performance...
Wooow! Show, that's great!
...Lady Sheela...
Understood. I'll borrow the Aura Battler Billbine...!
Looks like we're all set, then.
Knowing the enemy's lying in wait for us... is pretty depressing, though.
Nie and I are going out too. Let's do our best!
Heh, an all-out battle, huh? Now I'm fired up.
If only Tobikage would show up...
Looks like even he can't cross the dimensional wall.
The Dinosaur Empire's old junk keeps pouring in, though, right?
That guy just doesn't have enough guts.
Honestly, we usually tell him to stay away. Talk about unfair.
If guts were all it took, everyone in Londo Bell could make it here.
Let's just go. Once that battleship's repaired, we've got no chance.
All right. ...Lady Sheela, we're going.
It frustrates me that all I can do is ask this of you, Holy Warrior Show Zama.
If the Gran's adjustments are done in time... I will come to support you.
Lady Sheela... if you push yourself too hard, it'll all be for nothing.
Please leave this to us.
The Billbine is plenty, Lady Sheela.
...Very well. Oh, yes. El, Bell!
You called, Lady Sheela?
Yaaay! Lady Sheewa, you called? You called?
Please take these two with you as support.
They should be of some help.
Just leave it all to meee!
Will you be okay? Fighting is scary, you know!
I'm not a scaredy-cat like you, Cham!
Let me ride in the Billbine! Okay, Holy Warrior?
...All the tension's suddenly gone...
...Great, it's gonna be three times as noisy.
We aren't going off to die.
Maybe being this cheerful is just right.
Captain, it's time.
Right. ...All units, head for Drake's castle. Show, please lead the way.
Understood. Lady Sheela, farewell.
...Good fortune in battle, Holy Warrior Show Zama... and surface people.
